title: Re-point the macos-14 arm64 runner to macos-15 before the image is retired (2026-11-02)
description: GitHub retires the macOS 14 runner images on 2026-11-02 and fails every macos-14 job in scheduled brownouts before that (actions/runner-images issue 13518). The darwin-arm64 leg of prepublication-qualification.yml (runs-on macos-14) was cancelled by a brownout on the v0.15.0 tag run 41321796131, so no candidate-bundle or native-execution-receipt exists for that tag. The workflow runs at the tag ref, so the tag cannot be qualified without a fixed workflow on the commit it names. Fleet scan (leader, 2026-11-01): macos-14 appears only in prepublication-qualification.yml:126 and projection-platform.yml:38,40 in this repository. macos-15 is arm64; macos-15-intel stays the x64 leg. CI-workflow edit on the release path: DEC-182 (1), floor and Opus review before commit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No workflow file in the repository names macos-14: prepublication-qualification.yml and projection-platform.yml run the darwin-arm64 leg on macos-15
The projection-platform matrix keeps one job per (platform, arch) with distinct names
The change lands under a fresh Opus review at the final head, and source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check are green on it

Run ids 41324393657 (prepublication-qualification) and 41324395938 (projection-platform), dispatched on main e0a559dd, are green on the macos-15 legs, AND the darwin-arm64 "Attest the committed artifact" step succeeds on macos-15 in a tag run of prepublication-qualification (the step runs only on a tag, so the dispatch runs do not exercise it; cite that tag run id)

implementationNotes:
LANDED 2026-11-01: opum-ai/quest-cli#718 (head 9b89de36, squash e0a559dd on dev) after a fresh Opus review, unit quest-cli-review-718, VERDICT APPROVE at 9b89de36 (spawn-model MATCH claude-opus-5-5, reviewer floor CLEAR, 3 of 3 files read); source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check green. Promoted to main by fast-forward via opum-ai/quest-cli#719: main is e0a559dd.

MEASURED on main e0a559dd, workflow_dispatch, no tag: prepublication-qualification run 41324393657 concluded success; darwin-arm64 ran on macos-15 (runner GitHub Actions 1000047750) and succeeded; all six quest-package-* artifacts and quest-candidate-bundle exist; native-execution-receipt was SKIPPED, because it is tag-only. projection-platform run 41324395938 concluded success: macos-15 (arm64) on macos-15 and macos-15 (x64) on macos-15-intel both success, six jobs. The earlier failure this fixes: v0.15.0 tag run 41321796131 had its darwin-arm64 leg cancelled by the macOS 14 brownout (job 124895585275, runs-on macos-14).

REVIEWER MEDIUM FINDING, recorded as stated by the leader: the darwin-arm64 "Attest the committed artifact" step (git hash-object on the committed binary, AMFI-sensitive, see the AMFI note in the repository profile) runs only on a tag ref. So the branch dispatch above did NOT exercise it, and its first run on macos-15 is the tag run itself. AC4 was added for that reason.

TICKED AC1-AC3 (2026-11-01), each with its evidence; AC4 stays open for the tag run. AC1: git grep macos-14 over origin/main .github returns 0 rows at e0a559dd, and prepublication-qualification run 41324393657 ran darwin-arm64 on macos-15 (runner GitHub Actions 1000047750), conclusion success. AC2: projection-platform run 41324395938 (success) reports six distinct jobs, including "macos-15 (arm64)" on macos-15 and "macos-15 (x64)" on macos-15-intel; the leader read both runs by ref too. AC3: #718 head 9b89de36 carried the Opus VERDICT APPROVE (unit quest-cli-review-718, model MATCH claude-opus-5-5) and source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check were all success on that head before the merge, with no required row pending.
